svg.title: Buy-order book implementation with linked price levels and order lookup
svg.desc: A linked hash map stores buy-side price levels. Each price level owns a doubly linked list of orders. Three numbered callouts show placing a new order, matching and removing the head order, and cancelling an order through a separate order map.

g.text: Step 1. Find the Order in orderMap via OrderID
Step 2. Remove the Order element from the PriceLevel
